description: The authors specify a general framework for the assessment process consisting of four stages: (1) specify similarity between student answer and correct answer, (2) categorize student answer according to the answer categorization scheme, (3) check for important errors, and (4) calculate the mark via
title: General Assessment Framework for Automated Marking Across Domains

description: The General Diagnostic Model (GDM) is a cognitive-diagnosis student model in which learners carry ability vectors with one component per knowledge component and questions carry discrimination vectors and an easiness parameter, combined through a logistic probability of a correct answer.
title: General Diagnostic Model (GDM)

description: The general polytomous testlet model is an item response theory model for testlet-based tests containing both dichotomously and polytomously scored items.
title: General polytomous testlet model

description: The genetic nurturing design separates, within genotyped parent–offspring trios, polygenic scores based on alleles parents transmitted to their offspring from scores based on non-transmitted alleles.
title: Genetic nurturing design

description: The article builds on a gesture classification system that \"deconstructs robotic tissue dissection into basic surgical maneuvers,\" involving \"nine dissection gestures (e.g., hook) and four supporting gestures (e.g., retraction).\" Annotators label each gesture's name, duration, and arm, achieving 91.
title: Gesture-level video annotation method for robotic surgical skill assessment

description: The GMSM is a preliminary theoretical and operational framework for characterizing instructional gestures in L2 vocabulary learning.
title: Gesture Memory Support Model (GMSM): seven dimensions for characterizing instructional gestures
